listing.name: Tyrian 2000 / OpenTyrian2000 (andyvand)
listing.summary: Play OpenTyrian2000 using the upstream Windows package and its included data folder.

steps.title: Keep the portable package together
steps.instruction: Extract the Windows MinGW x64 ZIP into a separate folder. This selected package includes the upstream data directory; keep it beside opentyrian2000.exe.

steps.title: Use the included player
steps.instruction: Finish setup with opentyrian2000.exe and its folder, then choose Play. For other packages that require additional data, follow the upstream Tyrian 2000 data instructions.

steps.title: Keep your current copy when updating
steps.instruction: Apply upstream updates separately and keep your existing data, configuration and progress backed up. This downloaded copy remains upstream/player-owned.
